name: Skydeck Swords
description:
About This Game

Engage in the brutal art of ship-to-ship swordplay! Command a growing fleet of space galleons, each with unique tactical advantages and specialized abilities, capable of carving through any enemy in their path. Mix and match your fleet and support them with a dynamic deck of cards designed to alter the battlefield and seize the perfect position.

  • Non-Stop Action: Cards have no cost and can be played at any time!

  • Make Enemies Fight Each Other: Master positioning to avoid attacks and build power before striking!

  • Build While You Play: Find new cards, visit shops, and upgrade - all while you fight!

  • Grow Your Team: Rescue, repair and upgrade ships to build a perfect fleet!

  • Forge Your Fate: Visit the Oracle to alter future encounters in your favor!

In this golden age of space travel, massive wooden galleons traverse the cosmic winds, fueled by solar sails and ancient machinery. The galaxy is a beautiful, dangerous playground for everyone who dares to explore it. Here, gold is heavy, oxygen is a luxury, and a sharp Skydeck sword is the only law that matters!

In this world you are a pirate with nothing left to lose and a galaxy to gain. Your only path to freedom is the great chase: hunt down the most elusive targets and do what you do best - steal all the riches! Capture ships, hoard legendary loot, and grow in power until your name is feared by every soul across the stars and planets!
short_desc: Bring a sword to a ship fight! Become a pirate and command a fleet of ships armed with massive, hull-mounted swords in this unique roguelike deckbuilder. Navigate across the stars to rescue your crew and steal all the riches!
